folders.purpose: Repository root files and project-level entrypoints.
folders.designed_for: Humans, CI, package managers, and AI agents.
folders.notes: Contains root configuration, README, justfile, and project-level metadata.

folders.purpose: Stores local AI log handling notes and examples.
folders.notes: Reference-only docs surface for local logs.

folders.purpose: GitHub Copilot adapter surfaces including instructions, agents, prompts, hooks, and workflows.
folders.designed_for: GitHub Copilot users and CI automation.
folders.notes: Adapter layer; canonical workflow logic remains under docs/ai capabilities.

folders.purpose: Git hook entrypoints for local validation before commit.
folders.designed_for: Developers using local Git hook automation.
folders.notes: Thin wrappers that invoke scripts/hooks for policy checks.

folders.purpose: OpenCode runtime adapter surfaces including agents, commands, and skills.
folders.notes: Adapter layer for OpenCode; canonical policy remains in docs/ai and package templates.

folders.purpose: JSON schemas used by validators for catalog and manifest contracts.
folders.designed_for: Validation tooling and maintainers updating AI metadata formats.
folders.notes: Schema source of truth for generated AI package artifacts.

folders.purpose: Optional local developer environment profiles for shell, editor, terminal, and tool setup.
folders.notes: Configuration profiles are optional and may include machine-local assumptions.

folders.purpose: Repository documentation for setup, AI workflow, and operating guidance.
folders.designed_for: Humans and AI agents reading durable project instructions.
folders.notes: Canonical guidance surface for repo-specific behavior and procedures.

folders.purpose: Reusable cross-runtime AI workflow package source and assets.
folders.designed_for: Teams bootstrapping AI workflows in external repositories.
folders.notes: Portable package benchmark; in-package examples are not installer targets and are excluded from maintained repo-structure outputs.

folders.purpose: Governance policy instances consumed by script-level policy enforcement.
folders.designed_for: Maintainers defining allow, deny, and confirmation command behavior.
folders.notes: Policy instances live here; schema contracts live in .schemas.

folders.purpose: Non-runtime reference and learning material, including PHP examples and scaffolds.
folders.designed_for: Humans and AI agents needing local language and pattern references.
folders.notes: Reference corpus is not runtime-critical unless explicitly used by a tool or test.

folders.purpose: Operational scripts for Copilot workflows, verification, search, context packing, and hooks.
folders.designed_for: Humans and AI agents running repeatable repo workflows.
folders.notes: Execution surface for guarded automation and evidence-oriented checks.

folders.purpose: PHP and shell test suites plus fixtures for workflow verification.
folders.designed_for: Maintainers verifying behavior and preventing regressions.
folders.notes: Covers validators, shell wrappers, and context-tree workflows.

folders.purpose: Utility scripts and reference corpora including AI tooling and PHP examples.
folders.designed_for: Maintainers and agents generating catalogs, exports, and docs artifacts.
folders.notes: Contains generators/validators plus non-runtime reference material.
